clinical_significance_note: in medical data, extreme values are often the most clinically significant data points in the dataset rather than measurement errors. A creatinine of 12.4 mg/dL likely indicates renal failure.

options.label: Include the 3 outlier value(s) in the analysis as potentially clinically significant; annotate as statistical outliers
options.consequence: the values stay in `creatinine` and in every statistic; their rows are marked in `creatinine_outlier_flag`

options.label: Exclude the 3 outlier value(s) pending clinical review
options.consequence: the values are set to missing in `creatinine`, so they drop out of every statistic; their rows are kept and marked in `creatinine_outlier_flag`
